claims.text_en: BTS Chit Lom (code E1, Sukhumvit line) opened 5 December 1999 at 13.7441083 N, 100.5430972 E - identical to the app's unit center. A Sky Walk links the station to the Ratchaprasong intersection (CentralWorld, Gaysorn Plaza, Erawan Shrine) and onward to Siam station; Central Chidlom department store has a direct skybridge from the station. The dispatch brief's '@13.7385-ish' coordinate is contradicted by both batch.json and Wikipedia; 13.7385 sits near Phloen Chit station, not Chit Lom.

claims.text_en: The unit's anchor is the Ratchaprasong intersection: the Erawan Shrine (formally Thao Maha Phrom), whose Phra Phrom statue was enshrined on 9 November 1956 after a string of mishaps during the Erawan Hotel's construction (wrong foundation date, cost overruns, injuries, a lost marble shipment), stands beside the Grand Hyatt Erawan; CentralWorld - one of the world's largest malls, served by both Chit Lom and Siam stations - fronts the same junction.

geography.notes: CentralWorld straddles the siam/chit-lom seam (coordinator check).

evidence.paraphrase: Shrine built for the government Erawan Hotel after construction mishaps; statue enshrined 9 Nov 1956; near Grand Hyatt Erawan at Ratchaprasong, near BTS Chit Lom.
CentralWorld at Ratchaprasong served by Siam and Chit Lom stations.

claims.text_en: The area's defining security event: on 17 August 2015 at 18:55 a 3 kg TNT pipe bomb detonated near the Erawan Shrine, killing 20 bystanders and injuring 125. Earlier, the 2010 political confrontation damaged CentralWorld itself - arson closed the mall on 19 May 2010, with most of it reopening 28 September 2010 and the Zen wing only in January 2012.

geography.notes: Incident history, not a current crime-rate measurement.

evidence.paraphrase: 3 kg TNT pipe bomb in a backpack, 20 killed, 125 injured, detonated 18:55.
Arson damage closed CentralWorld 19 May 2010; mall reopened 28 Sep 2010; Zen reopened 6 Jan 2012.

claims.text_en: Piers: the app counts 5, but OSM resolves this to 2 distinct Khlong Saen Saep boat stops inside the unit - Pratunam (the Golden Mount line's western terminus/interchange; 4 duplicate ferry_terminal nodes at 595-621 m) and Chidlom (ferry_terminal node at 537 m plus a pier way at 523 m). A third nearby stop, Wireless/Witthayu (721 m from the app center), is 583 m from Phloen Chit station and so falls outside this unit's nearest-stop cell. The count of 5 matches the number of OSM ferry_terminal nodes (4 Pratunam duplicates + 1 Chidlom), i.e. an OSM-dedup artifact rather than five destinations.

question_answers.notes: Identity: E1 at the Ratchaprasong junction - shrine, CentralWorld, Central Chidlom, skywalk spine. App center equals the true station site; the dispatch brief's coordinate was wrong (flagged).
Everyday experience: office-tower weekdays, shrine pilgrims and tourists daily, mall-scale food and retail within one skywalk.
Values: transport=10 (E1 + skywalk + canal piers) and DE=10 (malls/department store) are mechanism-backed; rent=1 rides on the corridor's luxury layer.
Counter-evidence: the 120k override vs corridor median ~40k and 2BR average 99.6k; security history qualifies the safety=7.
Rhythm: office peaks, boat hours 05:30-20:30, shrine all-day, malls 10-22.
Walkability: elevated Sky Walk network is the spine; straight-line distances only, no radius-to-time conversions.
Daily life: Central Chidlom department store via skybridge, CentralWorld/Big-C-class retail nearby, canal boats to the old town.

Explicit override treatment: 45,000 matches district/corridor 1-bed averages; 120,000 is top-decile luxury 2-bed asking (Athenee 120k example; Aman/One Bangkok anchors), roughly a third above the FazWaz 2-bed average and ~3x the corridor median - a luxury-anchored estimate, not a median.
Green=9 with 4.2 ha unresolved: unnamed OSM polygons + possible Lumphini north-lobe contribution; no flagship park verified inside.
Fit: corporate/hospitality workers and luxury renters; poor fit for budget renters - the override documents the ceiling, the median documents the floor.
2024-2026: One Bangkok phased opening south of the unit; Aman Nai Lert opened at the eastern edge - both reprice the corridor's luxury layer.
Outside-the-score: pier-count dedup artifact, unnamed park identity, Aman cell assignment, and the override's unexposed derivation.

preview.text_en: Chit Lom is Ratchaprasong at its most valuable: the Erawan Shrine corner, a skywalk spine into CentralWorld and Central Chidlom, canal boats from Pratunam - and the app's highest rent figure (45,000/120,000), which the market data says is a top-decile luxury number, not a median one.

guide_lead.text_en: One stop east of Siam, Chit Lom swaps the student square for shrine incense and office-tower lobbies: E1 on the Sukhumvit line, wired by skywalk to CentralWorld, Gaysorn and Central Chidlom, with Khlong Saen Saep boats at Pratunam and Chidlom piers. Its transport, food and daily-essentials scores rival Siam's; its rent record - a 45,000/120,000 station override dated 2026-10-21 - is the steepest in the app, and the listings show exactly who pays it.

strengths.text_en: A walkable retail-and-shrine core: E1 station with a direct skybridge into Central Chidlom and a Sky Walk running through Ratchaprasong to Siam, with two canal-boat piers (Pratunam interchange, Chidlom) adding a water route the malls cannot.
Food and nightlife depth (624 food, 83 cafes, 39 nightlife per app) anchored by CentralWorld-scale retail and the shrine's all-day draw.

tradeoffs.text_en: The 120,000 rent headline is a top-decile luxury figure: corridor medians run near 40,000 and the FazWaz 2-bed average is 99,600 - rent=1 is earned by the district, but the override overstates the typical renter's price point by about a third.
Security history is heavy for a shopping district: the 2015 Erawan Shrine bombing (20 killed, 125 injured) and the 2010 CentralWorld arson sit inside the unit's memory, qualifying safety=7.
Green=9 rests on unverified composite polygons - no flagship public park is confirmed inside the unit.

day_night.text_en: Weekdays belong to the office towers and lunch queues; early evening shifts to the shrine (guide-era window 06:00-midnight) and the food strip; boats stop at 20:30 weekdays and 19:00 weekends; the mall system closes around 22:00 and the unit's residential streets go quiet with it.

within_area_variation.text_en: The skywalk-mall layer around the station is a different world from the canal-side blocks 600 m north (pier lanes, older low-rise) and from the green ambiguity at the unit's southern edge toward Lumphini's northern lobe - three textures the single 4.2 ha park figure flattens.

conditional_fit.text_en: Fit for corporate and hospitality workers, shrine-adjacent lifestyle renters, and luxury-budget households who want two rail lines' reach without Siam's crush.

Poor fit for typical-budget renters: if 45,000-120,000 reads as the market, the 40,000-100,000 reality of most corridor stock still prices out the Bangkok median - and crowd=1 weekends at the shrine-mall corner are part of the deal.

uncertainties: The 120,000 override's derivation is unexposed; the top-decile-luxury reading is the researcher's, anchored on an Athenee Residence listing at exactly 120k (snippet-level) plus new luxury anchors (chit-lom-c08).
Pier count 5 = 4 duplicate Pratunam OSM nodes + 1 Chidlom node; 2 distinct stops served (chit-lom-c04).
4.2 ha park composition unresolved; unnamed OSM polygons unverified (chit-lom-c05).
Aman Nai Lert's cell assignment (chit-lom vs phloen-chit Voronoi) unknown; opening date snippet-level only.
Dispatch brief's '@13.7385' coordinate contradicts batch.json and Wikipedia (13.7441); app data internally consistent.
